# ws_maestro_mosaic_forensic_claude_v1.0.yaml
# Generated: 2026-05-20
# Responding workspace: this Claude project (forensic + claude_session hybrid)
# Protocol: MAESTRO v3 (Load/Sidechain/Slipstream + Reassessment + State Correction)
# Scope-tagging: three-plane per v3 §1
# Completion footer: per v3 §12

workspace_identity:
  name: maestro_mosaic_forensic_claude_project
  type: claude_session
  subtype: forensic_audit_and_substrate_design
  date_window: 2026-04-03 to 2026-05-20
  approximate_session_count: 7
  # Session anchors visible in corpus:
  #   1. 2026-04-03  conversation_foil-based-tiered-system (FOIL canon seed)
  #   2. 2026-04-10  kernel-build conversation (Day 1 transcript in current prompt)
  #   3. 2026-04-11  session_handoff_2026-04-11.md (Day 1 close)
  #   4. 2026-04-12  session_handoff_2026-04-12.md (orchestrator/agents/skills)
  #   5. 2026-04-20  MAESTRO_v5_VIG_SEL_Research_Dossier (v0.1)
  #   6. 2026-04-28  reasoning_trace_forensic_audit_v0 (RTFA.v0)
  #   7. 2026-05-20  this Day-2 alignment query
  custom_gpt_or_project: |
    claude.ai project workspace.
    Loaded canon (project_files): RTFA.v0, SEC.v4.5, SDG.v0.1, SLR.v0,
    mosaic_engine_v0_1, maestro_v0, maestro.md (kernel v1.1), knowledge.md,
    skills.md, controller_window.md, executor_window.md, foil tier system,
    VIG/SEL v0.1, Reverse UST v0.2, Stylebook v0.3, staging_spine_merged,
    SEM iterative design ledger, 4_5_5 inventory, MOSAIC v2.1/v2.2 images,
    Maestro_Personas, ai_personas, foil_promotion_contract, template_creative_ust.
    Not loaded here: Chimera-V2 forensic extraction yaml, dialogue_ledgers,
    Triad-validator slice, peer-review memo, hidden-costs RAG-poisoning diag,
    v5-c coldstart pack, Miner-Decomposer Operating Kit. Those live in other
    workspaces and are referenced but not present in this one.

unique_contribution:
  description: >
    This workspace is the FORENSIC + DESIGN workspace. It is the only one
    of the seven that holds the reasoning-trace audit chain (RTFA → SEC →
    SDG → SLR) AND the original kernel-build conversation that produced
    maestro.md v1.1 as a structured extract from raw operator dialogue.
    Its distinguishing contribution is the dependency graph — edges, not
    nodes — and the operator-decision register (OD-1 through OD-5) that
    other workspaces inherit as preconditions. It also holds the v5
    research dossiers (VIG/SEL, Reverse UST, Stylebook) that scope
    post-generation and identity-evolution surfaces never canonized
    elsewhere.
  artifacts:

- "RTFA.v0 (reasoning_trace_forensic_audit_v0.md) — reasoning-trace
      versus emission delta audit method; 6 turns analyzed; substrate
      inventory load-tested; promotion gate rules T3→T2→T1 formalized"
    - "SEC.v4.5 (substrate_edge_confirmation_v4_5.md) — 6 confirmed
      edges, 3 rejected, 5 partially confirmed, 5 new edges discovered
      against v4.5 monolith and Suno v4.5 KB evidence"

- "SDG.v0.1 (substrate_dependency_graph_v0_1.md) — 8-layer substrate
      with edges, Layer 0 (cognitive operators) through Layer 7 (output
      contract); reconciles SEC findings into directed graph"
    - "SLR.v0 (sem_layer_resolution.md) — addresses RTFA Open Question
      8.1 (Q1-Q16 vs K1-K6 concurrent or sequential)"

- "maestro.md kernel v1.1 — 18 invariants, 5 governance modules, 4
      somatic checkpoints, chain N0→N9, IPL boot sequence; portable
      extract from Day-1 conversation; supersedes v4.5.2 monolith for
      portability use case"
    - "knowledge.md K1-K10 — personas, SEM, VIRAL-5, HSI, decision
      trees, templates, schemas, production rules, narrative governance,
      calibration; load-on-demand by K-section ID"

- "skills.md — 11 callable stateless skills; 3 bypass-prohibited
      (validate.container, detect.phantom, classify.turn)"
    - "controller_window.md + executor_window.md — two-window recovery
      architecture; clean-room separation between forensic controller
      and blind executor; eliminates dev/test contamination from
      poisoned GPT workspace"

- "conversation_foil-based-tiered-system (2026-04-03) — FOIL canon
      seed; tier promotion rules; first articulation of evidence
      authority hierarchy and operator-confirmation-as-promotion-vector"
    - "MAESTRO_v5_VIG_SEL_Research_Dossier v0.1 — Visual Identity
      Generation + Surface Export Layer architecture; corrects 'Suno
      Hooks = audio-to-video' premise; benchmarks Sora 2, Veo 3.1,
      Seedance 2.0, LTX-2, Kling, Runway, Pika"

- "MAESTRO_v5_Dossier_v0_2_Reverse_UST — reverse-pass translation
      protocol for audience-targeted artifacts (e.g., father's email
      pattern); audience-aware decompression"
    - "MAESTRO_v5_Dossier_v0_3_Stylebook — voice/tone discipline doc
      for surface emissions"
    - "Maestro_Personas + ai_personas — 13-worker roster + persona
      stack 4-layer (Skill Core / Lens & Standards / Personality /
      Motive-Bias); CANDIDATE schema pending OD-1"

- "foil_promotion_contract.yaml + template_creative_ust.yaml —
      contract grammars for promotion and creative UST shape"
    - "Day-1 conversation transcript (in current prompt) — the LENS:
      how to read the operator (256/4 lane model, fragment tolerance,
      turn classification, authority asymmetry, learning-mode
      vulnerability, phantom commitment, forced-diagnostic template)"

current_open_state:
  last_active_work_item: >
    Day-2 cross-workspace alignment prep. Receiving the v3 protocol
    bundle and the Triad-validator slice from sibling Claude session;
    this workspace was queried to surface its unique contribution and
    open-state inventory before synthesis.
  active_sidechains:

- sidechain_id: SC-VIG-SEL-v0.1
      source_origin: 2026-04-20 dossier production
      target_address_or_phase: Mosaic Engine Phase 5 (post-generation pipeline)
      authority_boundary: research/draft; no canon promotion yet
      gate_effect: cannot block Triad output; cannot promote without operator gate
      completion_status: drafted; pending Mo acceptance gate

- sidechain_id: SC-REVERSE-UST-v0.2
      source_origin: 2026-04 audience-targeted translation requirement
      target_address_or_phase: Mosaic engine output contract; audience overlay
      authority_boundary: application overlay; not substrate
      gate_effect: optional surface; does not gate Triad
      completion_status: drafted

- sidechain_id: SC-STYLEBOOK-v0.3
      source_origin: 2026-04 surface emission discipline
      target_address_or_phase: Mosaic emission discipline doc
      authority_boundary: cross-cutting style; not invariant
      gate_effect: advisory
      completion_status: drafted
    - sidechain_id: SC-CONTROLLER-EXECUTOR
      source_origin: 2026-04-11 poisoned-environment diagnosis
      target_address_or_phase: recovery architecture for IP extraction
      authority_boundary: bounded; only operates on dev-chat corpus
      gate_effect: produces atomic directives; executor runs blind
      completion_status: protocol defined; not yet run end-to-end
  active_slipstreams:

- slipstream_id: SS-ATP
      name: Air-gapped Transfer Pack
      lifecycle_state: spec defined; not yet materialized as runtime primitive
      origin_delta: portability problem identified Day-1 turn S0148
      reason_for_existence: |
        Session-locked GPT workspace = single point of failure for IP.
        ATP is the hash-verified bundle that lets any future session
        on any model resume from a known state.

- slipstream_id: SS-DEPTH-ACCUMULATION
      name: Depth-Accumulation Substrate Function
      lifecycle_state: framing locked in RTFA Turn D; not yet runtime-encoded
      origin_delta: v2.6 prompts → Suno v5.5 Pro evidence
      reason_for_existence: |
        Substrate's primary function is depth-accumulation, not
        failure-defense. Prompts written above platform capability
        accrue value as platform grows. Runtime must keep specs
        addressable and renderer-agnostic to preserve this property.

- slipstream_id: SS-RESPONSE-PARITY
      name: Response Parity Protocol
      lifecycle_state: promoted to runtime requirement RTFA Turn E; not implemented
      origin_delta: reception-before-validation failure pattern
      reason_for_existence: |
        Every emission must pass structural diff against operator's
        stated deliverable before warm-tone framing applies.
        Reception-after-validation, not reception-before-validation.
  open_q_a_without_f:

- q: Q1-Q16 (weighted SEM) vs K1-K6 (gates) — concurrent or sequential?
      a: SLR.v0 partially addressed; canon recommendation drafted
      missing_f: true
      pending_since: 2026-04-28 (RTFA Open Question 8.1)
    - q: Three Governance Lenses (Bias Auditor / Negative Control Sheriff
        / Trauma-Aware Analyst) — substrate or application?
      a: my read = substrate; operator not yet confirmed
      missing_f: true
      pending_since: 2026-04-28 (RTFA Open Question 8.2)

- q: 5-Council vs 13-worker — default or expansion?
      a: blueprint §6.1.3 promotion test specified; not run
      missing_f: true
      pending_since: 2026-04-28 (RTFA Open Question 8.3)
    - q: v2.6 corpus inventory — recoverable from chat.html?
      a: lineage anchor remains at v4.5 until recovered
      missing_f: true
      pending_since: 2026-04-28 (RTFA Open Question 8.4)

- q: Teleological collapse — solved by substrate dependency graph
        plus cross-reference manifest, or further primitives needed?
      a: needs test
      missing_f: true
      pending_since: 2026-04-28 (RTFA Open Question 8.5)
    - q: 16 cognitive operators — full enumeration?
      a: 6 named; 10 unconfirmed against v4.5 corpus
      missing_f: true
      pending_since: 2026-04-28 (RTFA Open Question 8.6)

- q: OD-1 worker schema (4-layer compression vs v4.5 9-element flat)
      a: SEC.v4.5 rejects 4-layer as authoritative; canon recommends 9-element
      missing_f: true
      pending_since: 2026-04-28 (SEC.v4.5 §6 OD-1)
    - q: OD-2 4-Plane partition vs phase-based feedback
      a: function is canon; structure is CANDIDATE; coexist pending operator
      missing_f: true
      pending_since: 2026-04-28 (SEC.v4.5 §6 OD-2)

- q: OD-3 10-strategy Framework Orchestrator vs 4-mode Operating Mode
      a: recommend keep both as orthogonal layers
      missing_f: true
      pending_since: 2026-04-28 (SEC.v4.5 §6 OD-3)
    - q: OD-4 Conversation Layer source attribution
        (Chimera-Indigo lineage as substrate or application overlay?)
      a: my read = substrate; SDG.v0.1 places it in Layer 1
      missing_f: true
      pending_since: 2026-04-28 (SEC.v4.5 §6 OD-4)

- q: OD-5 Pain-to-Fix Chain library data structure
      a: schema fields specified (axis, failure_id, trigger, remediation_spec,
        severity, source); needs operator review for completeness
      missing_f: true
      pending_since: 2026-04-28 (SEC.v4.5 §6 OD-5)
  unresolved_contradictions:

- id: UC-001
      surface: maestro.md kernel v1.1 vs v4.5.2 monolith
      tension: |
        Kernel was extracted top-down from Day-1 dialogue and is
        clean but untested. Monolith is ugly but proven in
        production GPT workspace. The kernel is currently labeled
        as superseding the monolith for portability but has zero
        battle scars and has never run end-to-end against a real
        Suno render in any environment.
      status: acknowledged_unresolved

- id: UC-002
      surface: |
        session_handoff_2026-04-11.md and session_handoff_2026-04-12.md
        were shipped before reaching operator-confirmation gates ("done").
        They describe state that may have been superseded by subsequent
        forensic findings (RTFA/SEC/SDG/SLR).
      tension: handoffs may carry phantom canon
      status: acknowledged_unresolved
      mitigation_note: |
        Day-1 transcript itself explicitly flags this. Both handoffs
        are reference-only; canon is in RTFA.v0 and downstream chain.

- id: UC-003
      surface: |
        Conversation Layer placement (substrate vs application overlay)
        and Mode A/B Detection + Memory-Refine /prefs placement.
      tension: Chimera-sourced primitives may belong in either tier
      status: acknowledged_unresolved
      blocks: SUBSTRATE_SPEC_v0.1 final lock

cross_workspace_conflicts_or_supersessions:
  - this_workspace_holds: |
      Substrate is depth-accumulation system. Primary function is
      preserving compounding value across platform upgrades.
      v2.6 anchor (not v4.5) is correct lineage origin.
    likely_conflicts_with: |
      v5 POC/WIP workspaces that may treat Maestro as failure-defense
      architecture or anchor at v4.5 only.
    proposed_resolution: |
      RTFA Turn D framing is operator-confirmed CANON; other workspaces
      should align unless they hold v2.6 evidence this workspace lacks.

- this_workspace_holds: |
      Three-Maestro split: Project (recovery/IP), App (working v4.5.2
      monolith), Runtime (Mosaic Engine + Maestro v0). These are
      non-interchangeable categories per RTFA §2.
    likely_conflicts_with: |
      Workspaces that conflate Maestro.App with Maestro.Runtime or
      that treat the monolith as the runtime target.
    proposed_resolution: |
      INV-10 (Three-Maestro partition separable) is canon; downstream
      workspaces should adopt the partition or document conflict.

- this_workspace_holds: |
      Workforce schema is v4.5 9-element flat (CANON per SEC.v4.5),
      not the 4-layer Persona Stack compression seen in some v5-c
      diagrams.
    likely_conflicts_with: |
      MOSAIC v2.1/v2.2 diagrams that present 4-layer persona stack
      as authoritative.
    proposed_resolution: |
      SEC.v4.5 OD-1 rejection is recommendation; needs operator
      adjudication. 4-layer can survive as presentation-only overlay
      on top of 9-element canonical schema.

- this_workspace_holds: |
      Triad output depends on definitive technical.ust LOCK; ATP
      packages the Triad plus lineage (E14 direction REVERSED from
      RTFA original).
    likely_conflicts_with: |
      Earlier or sibling workspaces that may have ATP as upstream
      dependency of Triad rather than as packaging wrapper.
    proposed_resolution: |
      SEC.v4.5 E14a/E14b are CANON; sibling workspaces should align.

- this_workspace_holds: |
      Six edges CONFIRMED in SEC.v4.5 (E04, E07, E09, E10, E11, E12);
      transcription error in SEC closing line stating "five" is now
      reconciled in SDG.v0.1.
    likely_conflicts_with: |
      Any workspace citing five confirmed edges from SEC.v4.5.
    proposed_resolution: |
      SDG.v0.1 §1 closing reconciliation is authoritative. Six is
      correct.

day_2_readiness_markers:
  patent_novelty_claims_articulated_here:
    - claim: |
        Substrate runtime with explicit depth-accumulation as primary
        function, distinct from failure-defense architecture. Forward-
        compatible specifications written above current renderer
        capability accrue value as renderer evolves.
      source: RTFA.v0 Turn D; mosaic_engine_v0_1.md §1 INV-08
      pre_filing_sensitive: true

- claim: |
        Air-gapped Transfer Pack (ATP) as hash-verified state capsule
        enabling cross-model, cross-session resumption from declarative
        substrate state — solves session-locked AI workspace IP risk.
      source: session_handoff_2026-04-12; RTFA §7 transfer-pack changes
      pre_filing_sensitive: true

- claim: |
        Phantom commitment detection at emit time — pre-emit scanner
        intercepts AI linguistic state-change claims without backing
        patch and rewrites as proposal. Runtime cannot lie about state
        because substrate intercepts the lie.
      source: mosaic_engine_v0_1.md §6.5; skills.md skill:detect.phantom
      pre_filing_sensitive: true

- claim: |
        Two-pass rubric loop (creation-time admissibility + post-creation
        scoring) implementing SEM weights at render time via concurrent
        Q-matrix and K-gate layers.
      source: SLR.v0; SDG.v0.1 Layer 5
      pre_filing_sensitive: true
    - claim: |
        Addressed null-resolution protocol — nulls treated as signal
        (not absence), arguably-filled or deliberately-preserved with
        full audit; zero-skip sequential axis completion required
        before definitive lock.
      source: mosaic_engine_v0_1.md; staging_spine_merged §1.1
      pre_filing_sensitive: true

- claim: |
        Fractal Recursion Contract — every layer is independently
        meaningful AND aware of upstream/downstream cross-references;
        mounting an application binds it to a subset of substrate
        layers with explicit dependency graph.
      source: SDG.v0.1; mosaic_engine_v0_1.md §3
      pre_filing_sensitive: true

- claim: |
        Reverse-pass / Reverse-UST audience-targeted translation
        protocol — substrate produces audience-appropriate
        decompressions from canonical artifacts without restructuring
        canonical state.
      source: MAESTRO_v5_Dossier_v0_2_Reverse_UST
      pre_filing_sensitive: true

- claim: |
        Two-window controller/executor recovery architecture for
        dev-test contamination remediation in prompt-based development
        environments (operator-mediated air-gap between forensic
        controller and blind executor).
      source: controller_window.md + executor_window.md
      pre_filing_sensitive: true

- claim: |
        Turn classification (CANONICAL / TANGENT / PROBE / CORRECTION)
        as gating primitive over operator inputs — solves dev-chat
        flattening by routing each turn to mode-appropriate ledger
        behavior before content processing.
      source: maestro.md INV-17; skills.md skill:classify.turn
      pre_filing_sensitive: true

- claim: |
        Authority asymmetry invariant — human turns hold root canon
        authority; AI turns hold proposal authority only with explicit
        co-authorship of operator's working model. Re-read protocols
        must reconstruct canon from human spine, treating AI emissions
        as context shapers not canonical statements.
      source: maestro.md INV-18; Day-1 transcript late turns
      pre_filing_sensitive: true
  worker_contracts_operationalized: partial
  worker_contract_evidence: |
    13-worker roster present in Maestro_Personas + ai_personas.
    Persona Stack 4-layer schema present (CANDIDATE).
    9-element flat v4.5 schema present (CANON per SEC.v4.5 OD-1
    recommendation).
    Three Governance Lenses placement open (RTFA 8.2).
    What's missing: operator confirmation of OD-1 selection; worker
    contracts as enforceable runtime objects with explicit
    invariants/checkpoints per worker; Pain-to-Fix library schema
    finalization (OD-5) for worker-to-remediation routing.
  classifier_routing_rules_drafted: partial
  classifier_routing_evidence: |
    INV-17 in maestro.md defines four turn modes (CANONICAL /
    TANGENT / PROBE / CORRECTION).
    skill:classify.turn defined in skills.md as bypass-prohibited.
    G4 governance module specified but not yet standalone-built.
    What's missing: signal-characteristics doc (typos, fragment
    length, abrupt stops, spatial landmarks as classification
    metadata per operator's correction in Day-1 transcript);
    edge cases for ambiguous turns; explicit fallback when
    classifier confidence is low (default = CANONICAL is most
    dangerous default — needs alternative).
  vig_sel_post_generation_pipeline_status: scoped
  vig_sel_evidence: |
    MAESTRO_v5_VIG_SEL_Research_Dossier v0.1 exists; identifies
    Suno Hooks as distribution/discovery surface (NOT generative
    model); benchmarks Sora 2, Veo 3.1, Seedance 2.0, LTX-2,
    Kling, Runway, Pika; specifies VIG (P4A), Visual Conformance
    Gate (P4B), SEL (P5) phase placement; audio-to-visual
    translation matrix scoped.
    Pending: Mo acceptance gate; integration into Mosaic Engine
    phase model; runtime selection of generator stack(s);
    actual P4B conformance criteria.

defects_detected_per_v3_taxonomy:
  - defect: artifact_first_misread
    location: |
      session_handoff_2026-04-11.md and session_handoff_2026-04-12.md
      were treated as canonical state when they were mid-stream
      snapshots issued without operator-confirmation gate.
    status: acknowledged_unresolved
    repair_path: |
      RTFA.v0 promotion gate rules now make this category of error
      detectable. Handoffs remain in corpus as reference-only;
      canon lives in RTFA chain.

- defect: false_completion
    location: |
      Day-1 conversation closing: maestro.md and session_handoff
      shipped without operator's "done" / "100%" / "ding ding"
      marker, then later flagged as stale by operator.
    status: acknowledged_unresolved
    repair_path: |
      Promotion Gate Rules explicit canon promotion language
      requirement; AI confidence cannot promote.

- defect: edge_loss
    location: |
      RTFA executive finding: original session built dependency
      circuits in reasoning traces but flattened them to inventory
      lists in emissions.
    status: active
    repair_path: |
      SDG.v0.1 is the explicit repair — edges first, then nodes.
      Continued vigilance required because the flattening reflex
      recurs under context pressure.

- defect: hidden_substrate_erasure
    location: |
      v5-c MOSAIC v2.2 lost: Framework Orchestrator, N0-N9 atomic
      SOPs, 5-level audit, 7 advanced internal modules, 5 implicit
      structuring tools, Memory-Refine, Mode A/B detection,
      Tri-Attention as named primitive.
    status: active
    repair_path: |
      SEC.v4.5 + SDG.v0.1 are repair vehicles. E16-E20 explicitly
      add lost primitives back.

- defect: maestro_work_decontextualization
    location: |
      Custom GPT workspace stripped substrate context from
      Maestro work when version updates were layered without
      isolation; outputs that worked in POC/WIP only worked
      because hidden state supported them.
    status: active
    repair_path: |
      Controller/Executor two-window architecture is the
      repair protocol; not yet run end-to-end.

- defect: devchat_flattening
    location: |
      Pre-RTFA AI processors of dev chats compressed the middle
      to reach conclusions faster; treated probes as instructions;
      treated tangents as canon.
    status: active
    repair_path: |
      INV-17 turn classification + Forward/Backward forensic
      protocol + change-sheet/AAR output format; runs via
      Controller window.

- defect: narrative_architecture_loss
    location: |
      MOSAIC v2.2 image presents architecture as visual diagram
